📰 Liquid AI Releases LiquidCodec, a 74M-Parameter Streaming Audio Codec

Liquid AI released LiquidCodec, a ~74M-parameter streaming audio codec that powers LFM3-Audio-2B and LFM3-Omni-2B. It runs at 12.5 Hz with 12 codebooks and encodes about 361x faster than real time ...
